body:
Slice 5 of 6 of #635. Depends on #651 (its containment leg lives in the shared `segmented_map_consumers.rs` fixture).

## What

Replace #647's chunk-id-floor apparatus (`RecoveredIds` / `ClassIds` / `torn_digit_escape` / `json_string_token`, metadata.rs:5063-5624 in the closed PR — several hundred production lines and a large share of its surviving-mutant surface, whose only non-test caller discards the value it computes) with the minimum totality requires: flat-map max plus bounded `seg:` range max, total over damage, never under-approximating.

Fixes the finding still open at #647's close: a corrupted flat root (`{"chunk_map":{"a":1},...}`) was classed as optional and contributed 0 — converting a fail-closed answer into a silently low floor, the exact under-approximation the recovery path must never produce (a low floor lets the allocator re-mint a still-live chunk id).

Wire `max_chunk` to a real caller or delete it: `server/src/lib.rs:124` currently discards it.

## Acceptance

- a damaged object leaves `high_water_marks` `Ok` with a floor >= every live chunk id (including `seg:` ranges); a corrupted flat root fails closed per-object or contributes its true floor — never silently 0;
- the computed floor has a real caller, or the dead half is gone;
- `cargo xtask ci` green.

Part of #635 / #508 / epic #513.

milestone.description: First tagged release (Alpha). Scheduled after the two production-metadata milestones complete: #14 (Metadata Store FoundationDB) and #5 (M4 — Production metadata backend) — i.e. after the FDB go/no-go (#442) records go, the default flips to FDB, and TiKV development stands down (#443). No due date yet; it follows those two. Starts empty as the release marker.

title: core: chunk-id floor shrunk to what totality requires (635.5)
